question: As per the Census of India 2011, which Union Territory recorded the lowest population growth rate?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lakshadweep**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Lakshadweep** recorded the lowest population growth rate among Union Territories as per the Census of India 2011.
 
• The Census of India is conducted every 10 years and provides comprehensive data on the demographic characteristics of the population.
 
• Population growth rate is an essential indicator of demographic changes and helps in planning and resource allocation.
 
• Lakshadweep is the smallest Union Territory of India in terms of population.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Census of India** is the most reliable source of data on population and various other socio-economic parameters.
 
• It is conducted by the Office of the Registrar General and Census Commissioner, under the Ministry of Home Affairs, Government of India.
 
• The **Census 2011** was the 15th National Census of the country.
 
• The data collected includes population size, density, distribution, and various demographic characteristics such as age, sex, literacy, and occupation.
 
• The information from the census helps in the formulation of policies and programs aimed at improving the socio-economic conditions of the population.
